events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Eddie Palmieri Experience: An All-Star Celebration on November 13–14, 2026 at 7:30 PM in Rose Theater. Longtime Palmieri collaborators saxophonist Louis Fouché and bassist Luques Curtis music-direct a lineup of Palmieri alumni including Brian Lynch, Conrad Herwig, Herman Olivera and Nelson Gonzalez, with additional artists to be announced or presented by the venue.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a generic memorial set: Palmieri's own longtime collaborators Louis Fouché and Luques Curtis are shaping the program, and the band is drawn from musicians who actually worked inside his language. That makes the concert a living transmission of the rhythmic, harmonic and Afro-Caribbean vocabulary Palmieri pushed into modern jazz and salsa, rather than an outside reconstruction of it.
en.trip_verdict: Yes. S-tier for New York: worth a dedicated regional trip for listeners drawn to Latin-jazz lineage, groove and master-level ensemble playing. The direct Palmieri alumni connection makes this more consequential than a conventional tribute bill.
en.listen_before: The Sun of Latin Music; Vámonos Pa'l Monte (Remastered 2024)

es.why_it_matters: No es un homenaje genérico armado desde afuera: los colaboradores de largo tiempo de Palmieri, Louis Fouché y Luques Curtis, están construyendo el programa y la banda reúne músicos que trabajaron dentro de su propio lenguaje. Eso convierte la noche en una transmisión viva del vocabulario rítmico, armónico y afrocarribeño que Palmieri empujó hacia el jazz moderno y la salsa.
es.trip_verdict: Sí. S para Nueva York: vale un viaje regional dedicado si el eje es la genealogía del Latin jazz, el groove y la ejecución de primer nivel. La conexión directa con músicos de Palmieri la vuelve bastante más importante que un tributo convencional.
es.listen_before: The Sun of Latin Music; Vámonos Pa'l Monte (Remastered 2024)
